append_single_writer.note: one append per committed transaction, cold chain growing 0..200, warm process

verify_chain_10000_events.note: chain hashes recomputed for every event; object hashes reported separately

export_bundle_200_events_10k_chain.note: includes checkpoint signing, 10,200-row skeleton, zip, vault write, evidence append

earlier_run_not_discarded.note: First run, same machine, executed while five other engine workers were building/testing concurrently AND before the single-pass anchored-verification fix; kept for transparency. The later run above is the code as shipped but is also a single run on a shared, noisy machine - treat both as indicative, not typical.

known_bottleneck: create_checkpoint (used by every export) re-verifies the full chain; incremental verification from the previous anchor is the next fix. Contention tail latency (p99 up to ~1 s) comes from SQLite single-writer serialisation; PostgreSQL row locks not measured here.
